signal_grades.note: Each signal is tested on its own: when it appeared, did PHG move the way it predicts 5 trading days later (daily) or 7 hours later (hourly)? "Helpful" means right at least 58% of the time with a positive average move, "Misleading" means wrong more often than right, and "Too few" means under 10 examples so far.

today_paragraph: Philips is at $22.90, down 0.0% today. Price has slipped below its 20-day average, though the longer trend is still up. The overall score is neutral (+3), so signals are mixed.
